name: Brodawel Camping & Caravan Park
accommodation: Touring and tent pitches, some with electric hook-up
suitableFor: Campers, tourers and families with dogs
beachAccess: Describes itself as the closest touring and camping park to Rest Bay; guests report under half an hour's walk to Rest Bay
confirmedFeatures: Site shop, play area, indoor games room, Wi-Fi, direct Wales Coast Path access
overview: Brodawel is a family-run touring and camping park on the edge of Nottage, about a mile from the Glamorgan Heritage Coast. It calls itself the closest touring and camping park to Rest Bay, and the Wales Coast Path runs straight from the site. There is a shop, a play area and an indoor games room.
surfTripFit: Pitching here keeps you within walking distance of Rest Bay at a lower-key site than the big town parks.
